capabilities: Add icons to files, folders, tabs, titles and inline text
Store icon packs as zipped archives with an index for fast startup
Cache used icons as extracted .svg files on first render
Recolor icons at render time, including icons with hard-coded shape colors
Rescan edited icon packs from settings without restarting
extras: Icon packs are third-party and remain under their own licenses, listed in CREDITS.md. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: Originally a fork of Iconize by Florian Woelki, which is no longer maintained.
motivation: The author forked Iconize because it is no longer maintained and reworked icon pack storage so very large packs load fast.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to attach icons to files, folders, tabs, titles or inline text, and the previous icon plugin is unmaintained.

relations.evidence: GlyphIt is a fork of Iconize by Florian Woelki, which is no longer maintained.

summary: Icon plugin, forked from Iconize, that adds icons to files, folders, tabs, titles and inline text using compressed icon packs.
